topic: Doing good & present perfect vs past simple（做有意義的事＋現在完成式 vs 過去式時態陷阱）

shadow.speaker: Hsiao Bi-khim 蕭美琴（2025 年 11 月 7 日在比利時布魯塞爾歐洲議會 IPAC 年會的英文演講，中央社 Focus Taiwan 官方 YouTube）

chunks.text: When it comes to international participation, things have been so hard for us Taiwanese.
And yet, Taiwan has always sought to be a force for good in the world,
and we are grateful to all of you for your continuing support.
We don't just want to survive — we want democracies to thrive.

phrases.en: When it comes to + N / V-ing …
phrases.zh: 說到……、談到……（to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing）
一股正面的力量；帶來好影響的人或事

respond.prompt_en: What is one thing you have done (or want to do) to be a force for good in your school or community? Answer in one sentence.
respond.prompt_zh: 你曾經做過（或想做）什麼事，讓學校或社區變得更好？用一句英文回答。（可以用 I have always tried to… 或 When it comes to helping others, I…）

vocab.example: More than 200 students participated in the school sports day.
vocab.note: 蕭美琴原句名詞：international participation（國際參與）。⚠️ participate 一定要加 in：participate in a contest（不能說 participate a contest）。＝take part in。名詞 participant＝參加者。

vocab.example: Many young people seek advice from their teachers before choosing a school.
vocab.note: 蕭美琴原句：Taiwan has always sought to be a force for good.（完成式 has＋p.p.）⚠️ 不規則動詞：seek → sought → sought，沒有 seeked！seek to V＝試圖做……（比 try 正式）。

vocab.example: Only three people survived the plane crash.
vocab.note: 可直接接受詞：survive the earthquake（撐過地震），不用加 from。名詞 survival、survivor（倖存者）。

vocab.zh: 茁壯成長、興旺、蓬勃發展
vocab.example: These plants thrive in warm and wet weather.
vocab.note: 蕭美琴原句：We don't just want to survive — we want democracies to thrive. 對比記：survive＝只是「活下來」；thrive＝「活得很好、越來越好」。B2 寫作加分字。

vocab.example: Everyone in our group contributed to the science project.
vocab.note: 同一篇演講：We contribute to humanitarian aid, disaster relief… ⚠️ contribute to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing：contribute to making the world better。名詞 contribution。

grammar.title: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：in the last few days / over the past… / since / for
grammar.explain:
會考時態題每年必考，106 年「in the last few days」那題全國答對率只有 46%！
① 一直延續到「現在」的時間 → 現在完成式 have/has＋p.p.：in the last few days、over the past two months、so far、since＋過去時間、for＋一段時間（到現在還在）。
② since 的陷阱：since 後面的子句用「過去式」（since he came to Taiwan），主要子句才用完成式（He hasn't seen them）。
③ 已經結束的時間 → 過去簡單式：yesterday、last week、in 2023、… ago、when I was little。⚠️ 有 ago 就不能用完成式（✗ I have seen it two days ago）。
④ 還沒做、等一下才要做 → haven't＋p.p.：I haven't seen it. I'll watch it this Saturday.
🔑 判斷法：找「時間線索」——這段時間到現在還沒結束 → 完成式；已經結束 → 過去式。
⭐ B2 加分：have been＋adj. 很常見：Things have been so hard for us.（蕭美琴原句）
examples: The weather has been rainy and cloudy in the last few days. I hope the sun will come out soon. —— 106 會考：in the last few days 到現在 → has been（答對率 46%）
Tom has lost ten pounds over the past two months. He looks much thinner now. —— 104 會考：over the past two months＋looks thinner now → has lost
Taiwan has always sought to be a force for good in the world. —— 蕭美琴原句：always＋完成式＝「一直以來都……」

practice.question: My cousin moved to Canada in 2023. Since then, she ___ English every day.
practice.explanation: Since then＝從 2023 年那時起到現在 → 現在完成式 has spoken。spoke 是已結束的過去；speaks 只說習慣、沒有「從那時到現在」；is going to speak 是未來。

uoe.passage: Our school's volunteer club ___1___ a lot since it started three years ago. When it comes to ___2___ people in our community, the members never say no. Last month, more than fifty students ___3___ in a beach clean-up in Keelung. They also planted trees and flowers behind the gym, and thanks to their care, the little garden is now ___4___, full of flowers and butterflies.

gaps.explanation: since it started three years ago＝從三年前到現在 → 現在完成式 has grown。⚠️ since 後面的子句用過去式 started，主要子句才用完成式。
When it comes to＋V-ing：這裡的 to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 helping，不能接原形 help。
Last month＝已經結束的時間 → 過去簡單式 participated。有 last month、ago、yesterday 就不能用完成式！
full of flowers and butterflies＝長得非常好 → thriving（茁壯、興旺）。surviving 只是「勉強活著」；sinking 下沉；seeking 尋求。

quiz.question: The weather ___ rainy and cloudy in the last few days. I hope the sun will come out soon.
quiz.explanation: in the last few days＝最近幾天「到現在」→ 現在完成式 has been。had been 是過去完成式（要有另一個過去時間點）；will be / would be 意思不合。全國答對率只有 46%！

quiz.question: Paul misses his parents a lot. He ___ them since he came to work in Taiwan a year ago.
quiz.explanation: since＋過去式子句（he came…）→ 主要子句用現在完成式 hasn't seen（從那時到現在都沒見到）。⚠️ 別被 a year ago 騙去選過去式：ago 屬於 since 子句，不是主要子句。

quiz.question: I can't tell you what I think of the movie because I ___ it. I'll probably watch it this Saturday.
quiz.explanation: 到現在還沒看過、星期六才要看 → haven't seen（現在完成式表示「到目前為止還沒」）。won't see 和後面「星期六會看」矛盾；don't see / am not seeing 不表示經驗。

quiz.question: Over the years, Taiwan has always ___ to be a force for good in the world.
quiz.explanation: has always＋過去分詞 → seek 的三態是 seek–sought–sought，所以是 sought。seeked、saught 都不是真的字（拼字陷阱）；seeking 不能接在 has 後面。

quiz.question: The little cat was lost in the mountains for five days without food, but luckily it ___.
quiz.explanation: 五天沒食物、幸好「活下來了」→ survived。thrived 是「長得很好、興旺」，餓了五天不會 thrive；contributed 貢獻、participated 參加，意思不合。

quiz.question: When it comes to ___ money for the school trip, Amy always has great ideas.
quiz.explanation: When it comes to 的 to 是介系詞 → 後面接 V-ing：raising。⚠️ 看到 to 就選原形是會考常見陷阱（look forward to / be used to / contribute to 也一樣）。
quiz.source: phrase: when it comes to (會考 to+V-ing 陷阱)

dialog.greet: Good morning, Roby! Ready for today's lesson? 早安，Roby！今天也一起加油吧！
dialog.present: Today: 'have done' or 'did'? Look for the time clue! 今天的重點：找時間線索，決定用完成式還是過去式。
correct: Excellent! You found the time clue. 太棒了，你抓到時間線索了！
Well done — that's exactly right! 完全正確，好厲害！
Great job! You've really got it. 很好，你真的懂了！
wrong: Almost! Check the time words again. 差一點！再看一次時間詞。
No worries — mistakes help us learn. 沒關係，錯誤會讓我們進步。
Look for 'since', 'ago' or 'last…'. 找找看有沒有 since、ago 或 last…。
dialog.hint: Is the time finished, or does it continue until now? 這段時間已經結束了，還是一直到現在？
dialog.submit: Let's check your answers together. 我們一起來對答案吧！
dialog.done: You have worked hard today — I'm proud of you! 你今天很認真，我以你為榮！
